sub.txt.adsh: Accession number (unique identifier for the submission; used to join with other files).
sub.txt.cik: Central Index Key (unique SEC identifier for the company; use this to identify a company, e.g., Apple is 0000320193).
sub.txt.name: Name of the registrant (company).
sub.txt.nciks: Number of CIKs in the submission.
sub.txt.aciks: List of CIKs in the submission.

num.txt.adsh: Accession number (links to sub.txt). Filing identifier, used to join with other files (e.g., sub.txt).
num.txt.tag: Tag identifying the XBRL concept. The specific financial concept reported (e.g., revenue, expense, asset).
num.txt.version: Taxonomy version (e.g., us-gaap/2024). The taxonomy version for the tag.
num.txt.coreg: Co-registrant CIK (if any, usually blank). If present, indicates a co-registrant.
num.txt.ddate: Date for the data value (YYYYMMDD), usually period end date. The date the value applies to (e.g., end of quarter or year).
num.txt.qtrs: Number of quarters the value covers (1 = current quarter, 2 = half-year, 4 = full year, 0 = point-in-time/beginning balance). How many quarters the value covers: 1 = single quarter, 4 = full year, 0 = point-in-time (e.g., balance sheet item).
num.txt.uom: Unit of measure (e.g., USD, shares, perShare). The unit of measure (e.g., USD for dollars).
num.txt.segments: Segment or dimensional context for the value (e.g., business segment, geographic area). If present, specifies the business/geographic segment or other dimension; blank means consolidated.
num.txt.value: Numeric value for the concept. The reported number.
num.txt.footnote: Footnote reference (if any, usually blank). Reference to a footnote (if any, usually blank).

pre.txt.stmt: Statement type (e.g., BS = Balance Sheet, IS = Income Statement, CF = Cash Flow).
pre.txt.negating: Negating (Y/N, indicates if value is negated).

security_identification.note: CIK is the unique SEC identifier for a company. To identify a company (e.g., AAPL), use its CIK in sub.txt. Ticker symbols are not present in these files; use an external mapping if needed.
